answer: A newcomer earns a seat only by taking a sextant fix on a named nebula from a named island, while two observers on neighbouring islands take the same fix; all three readings must agree within half a degree, and a mismatch voids the claim and burns a 300 POA bond. The island orchard feeds the observers, and each fix needs a $260 sextant plus a $40 observer fee, so 100 fake identities need 100 fixes, $30,000 in fees and 30,000 POA in bonds.
